section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch23 — Geography — Deep Practice 3
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The highest peak in India, Kangchenjunga, is located in which mountain range?
explanation: Kangchenjunga, on the India-Nepal border, is part of the Himalayas — the world's youngest and highest fold mountain system. It is the third-highest peak in the world.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch23 — Geography — Deep Practice 3
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Which major Indian river originates in Tibet and flows through Arunachal Pradesh (as the Siang/Dihang) before joining the Brahmaputra system?

options.option_text: The Brahmaputra itself (originating as the Yarlung Tsangpo in Tibet)

explanation: The Brahmaputra originates in Tibet as the Yarlung Tsangpo, enters India through Arunachal Pradesh as the Siang/Dihang, and becomes the Brahmaputra in Assam. The Ganga originates at Gangotri in Uttarakhand; the Indus also rises in Tibet but flows through Ladakh into Pakistan.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch23 — Geography — Deep Practice 3
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Bhopal is the capital of which Indian state?
explanation: Bhopal is the capital of Madhya Pradesh. Uttar Pradesh's capital is Lucknow; Rajasthan's is Jaipur; Chhattisgarh's is Raipur/Naya Raipur.
